_about: Methyl acetate (1) + n-Heptane (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 1500.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of methyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Badajoz, P. S.[Pedro Susial], Garcia-Vera, D.[Diego], Marrero-Perez, A.[Anibal], Padron-Guerra, N.[Nieves], Mujica-Gonzalez, T.[Tatiana], Measurement of VLE Data by Using an Experimental Installation with Automatic Control: Modeling of Binary Systems of Methyl Acetate or Ethyl Acetate with n-Heptane or 2,2,4-Trimethylpentane at Both 0.1 and 1.5 MPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 64 (2019) 5591-5608
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 14, 15. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.49 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
